{"metadata":{"description":"Turn DeepSeek Harness into a Codex-style desktop app: native WebView2 shell, system tray, auto-start, Windows toasts, and a Desktop settings tab with a one-of-N skin center.","id":"gh:1333422728","install_available":false,"language":"JavaScript","name":"Deepseek-Harness-as-Desktop","slug":"KhanZou/Deepseek-Harness-as-Desktop","topics":["dsh-plugin"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Turn DeepSeek Harness into a Codex-style desktop app: native WebView2 shell, system tray, auto-start"},{"id":"p1s2","text":", Windows toasts, and a Desktop settings tab with a one-of-N skin center."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# DeepSeek Harness as Desktop"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"> Turn DeepSeek Harness into a Codex-style desktop app: a native WebView2 shell, system-tray residen"},{"id":"p3s2","text":"cy, auto-start on logon, real Windows toasts, and a set of DSH plugins that add a desktop settings t"},{"id":"p3s3","text":"ab, a standalone card-based skin center, reusable right/bottom panels, a Git graph, file/SCM browsin"},{"id":"p3s4","text":"g, a mini terminal, and per-turn token statistics."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"中文文档"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## Features"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"- 🖥️ **Native WebView2 shell** (`DshDesktop.exe`, C# WinForms + WebView2, x64) — embeds the DSH Web "},{"id":"p6s2","text":"UI in a standalone app window.
- 🚀 **One-click launch** — the exe detects the backend (`127.0.0.1:30"},{"id":"p6s3","text":"80`); if it is not running, it starts `corepack pnpm dsh web` in the background automatically.
- 🧭 *"},{"id":"p6s4","text":"*System tray residency** — closing/minimizing hides to tray and keeps running in the background; tra"},{"id":"p6s5","text":"y menu *Open / Exit*. *Exit* stops the backend only if this exe started it.
- 🔁 **Launch at logon** "},{"id":"p6s6","text":"— optional HKCU `Run` key registration.
- 🔔 **Real Windows toasts** — task-completion notifications "},{"id":"p6s7","text":"appear in the Action Center (AUMID-registered unpackaged toast), with tray-balloon fallback.
- ✨ **I"},{"id":"p6s8","text":"nteractive toasts**
- 🧩 **`dsh-skill-manager` plugin** — per-workspace skill manager (enable/disable"},{"id":"p6s9","text":" project & global skills, copy/apply skill config between projects); ships as an external plugin dep"},{"id":"p6s10","text":"ending on the published `@deepseek-ai/dsh-*` workspace packages.
- 📱 **QQ notifications + remote con"},{"id":"p6s11","text":"versation** — step-by-step setup guide for `dsh-notifier` (outbound push to QQ, inbound remote appro"},{"id":"p6s12","text":"val/dialogue, the pitfalls we actually hit): `docs/qq-notifier-setup.md`.
— completion notifications"},{"id":"p6s13","text":" show a bounded **answer preview** (title maps the turn-end reason, tools are listed); a **quick-rep"},{"id":"p6s14","text":"ly input + Reply button** sends typed text back to the same session via the official DSH `session.pr"},{"id":"p6s15","text":"ompt` channel; **sandbox permission escalations** show *Allow once / Reject* buttons answered throug"},{"id":"p6s16","text":"h the official DSH `respond` channel. A COM activator (`INotificationActivationCallback`) reads in-t"},{"id":"p6s17","text":"oast text input.
- ⚙️ **Desktop settings tab** — a **Desktop** section in *Settings* manages close-b"},{"id":"p6s18","text":"utton behavior, auto-start, and notifications.
